displayName: MDO - Safe Links Click-Through to Malicious URL

queryCondition.queryText:
UrlClickEvents
| where ActionType == "ClickAllowed" or (isnotempty(IsClickedThrough) and IsClickedThrough != "0")
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| where isnotempty(AccountUpn)
| project Timestamp, ReportId, AccountUpn, Url, ThreatTypes, DetectionMethods, IPAddress, IsClickedThrough, Workload, NetworkMessageId

alertTemplate.title: Malicious link clicked (Safe Links click-through)
alertTemplate.description: A user clicked, or clicked through the Safe Links warning page to, a URL that Defender for Office 365 classified as Phish or Malware. High-confidence compromise candidate.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the user's subsequent sign-ins for anomalies, reset credentials and revoke sessions if compromise is confirmed. Block the URL/domain and hunt for other recipients.
